intro: A stores-management panel with a targeting screen. The Defuser must fly a full release checklist for every target card — one wrong RELEASE is a strike. The Defuser reads the target card aloud; you weaponeer it and talk them through the panel setup.
rules: If the target is MOVING, select AGM-65.
Otherwise, if the target is URBAN (collateral must stay LOW), select GBU-38.
Otherwise, if the target is HARDENED, select GBU-31.
Otherwise, if weather is CLEAR, select GBU-12.
Otherwise (static, open, soft, weather IMC), select GBU-31.
codeRules: LASER weapons (GBU-12, AGM-65): the code is 1, then the two digits from the middle of the serial number (positions 3 and 4).
GPS weapons (GBU-31, GBU-38): the code must read 000.
checklist: Rotate the STATION knob until the correct weapon shows.
Dial the 3-digit CODE on the thumbwheels.
Press RELEASE. Repeat for each target card.
After the final target: MASTER ARM back to SAFE, or the module never disarms.
